english: this is not the place to …
also: this is not the time to

terms.latin: nōn est hic locus ut (+ subj.)
terms.gloss: this is not the place to …
evidence: Traupman p. 105: this is not the place to …, nōn est hic locus ut (+ subj.)
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase; neither Lewis & Short nor the loci collections quote the construction with ut, so it is given here as modern.

sources: Lewis & Short: locus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 105, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
